exposure: Heart disease during pregnancy (congenital and acquired)
Type of heart disease (congenital vs. acquired)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 258 pregnant women (129 with heart disease and 129 healthy controls)
finding: Pregnant women with heart disease had higher rates of adverse perinatal outcomes compared to healthy pregnant women.
mod_finding: This study found that pregnant women with heart disease had higher rates of cesarean section compared to healthy pregnant women.
birth_weight: Lower in infants of mothers with heart disease
